meta.storyTitle: Isolate code reviews with commit-parent baseline workspaces

summary.prose: Code-review preparation will validate the submitted packet as the only review scope and turn its pinned local-Git provenance into an immutable, per-attempt baseline workspace containing only relevant pre-change files. Reviewers receive ordinary paths to the packet, baseline workspace, design/task artifacts and complete test evidence; checkpoint, recovery and publication behavior remain unchanged and source bodies are no longer retained in review records.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Isolate code reviews with commit-parent baseline workspaces

api.name: prepareReviewPacket
api.signature: prepareReviewPacket<Blob>(input: unknown, sources: ReviewSources<Blob>, historical?: boolean, route?: StoryRoute, stored?: StoredDerived, access?: ReviewPacketAccess<Blob>): Promise<PreparedReviewPacket<Blob>>

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: Submitted packet whose selected after blocks and deletion anchors exclusively define review scope.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.purpose: Pinned local-Git provenance and content access used to validate declared commits, parents and blobs.

parameters.name: historical
parameters.purpose: Indicates historical-attempt validation without changing the pinned attempt input.

parameters.name: stored
parameters.purpose: Previously stored derived checkpoint metadata used only when its identity matches the pinned packet.

parameters.name: access
parameters.purpose: Packet field accessor used during validation and preparation.

returns.meaning: A source-light prepared packet containing validated selected-change locators, artifact/task/test references and an immutable baseline-workspace manifest/path, without embedded source bodies or broad semantic hydration.

errors.condition: The final review revision is absent, not a full local object id, rewritten or inconsistent with selected after blobs.
A selected change is not contained in one of the declared local commits or requires uncommitted worktree content.
The applicable parent is absent, ambiguous for a merge, or not the parent against which the selected transition was made.
A materialized parent blob or after blob does not match the packet digest/path metadata.

preconditions: Every selected change is pinned to a declared local commit and the packet carries a full final review revision.
The selected after range/block or deletion anchor is the sole review-scope declaration.
Merge changes identify the applicable parent explicitly; no remote branch or origin state is required.
postconditions: Only selected changes appear in the prepared scope, even when declared commits contain unrelated changes.
Each non-new selected transition resolves to its exact applicable local parent blob and immutable workspace path.
New, deleted and renamed files retain explicit transition metadata; stacked edits retain each relevant transition.
Prepared/checkpoint data contains locators, digests and paths, not source bodies.
Reviewer, checkpoint history, recovery and publication state semantics are unchanged.

api.name: CodePreparation

parameters.name: packet
parameters.purpose: The pinned task-review packet to qualify and prepare.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.purpose: Local-Git object/provenance source used for qualification and selective baseline materialization.

returns.meaning: Attempt-scoped preparation owner that qualifies packet provenance, creates or reuses the immutable baseline workspace, exposes source-light reviewer context and closes owned resources.

errors.condition: Packet scope or provenance validation fails before reviewer invocation.
An existing attempt workspace does not match the pinned packet/workspace manifest identity.

preconditions: Review identity and attempt are fixed before preparation begins.
Preparation has an attempt-scoped temporary root and cleanup ownership.
postconditions: Preparation never broadens scope from Git status, commit breadth or live worktree state.
Closing releases transient resources without altering checkpoint review history.
A retry of the same pinned attempt either reuses an identical sealed workspace or fails closed.

api.name: StagedPacketConstruction

parameters.name: packet
parameters.purpose: Validated source-light packet being constructed in bounded stages.

returns.meaning: A staged construction boundary that seals packet metadata only after provenance and workspace integrity succeed.

errors.condition: Required provenance or workspace stages are incomplete.

preconditions: No source body is embedded into the packet/checkpoint representation.
postconditions: The sealed packet references immutable evidence by locator, digest and path.

api.name: StagedPacketSources

parameters.name: sources
parameters.purpose: Bounded source provider for selected commit, parent and blob qualification.

returns.meaning: Selected-change source view that resolves only packet-declared transitions and releases decoded results after validation/materialization.

errors.condition: A requested source is not named by a selected transition.

preconditions: Requested blobs correspond to packet-declared commits, parents and paths.
postconditions: Decoded bodies are not retained after verified files are materialized or digests checked.

dataModelChanges.details: Becomes source-light. It owns review identity, final revision, declared commits, selected after blocks/deletion anchors, per-transition local commit/parent/blob/path metadata, artifact/task/test references, and a baseline workspace manifest/path. It must not carry hydrated source bodies or broad context derived outside selected changes.
dataModelChanges.schemaDiff: Add per-selected-change provenance `{ originCommit, applicableParent, beforePath?, beforeBlob?, afterPath?, afterBlob?, changeKind, selection, mergeParentIndex? }` and baseline workspace `{ root, manifestDigest, entries[] }`; prohibit embedded source bodies.

dataModelChanges.details: Production construction must seal only after packet provenance and baseline workspace integrity are verified; the existing class becomes part of the production preparation path rather than a test-only/isolated helper.
Source acquisition is restricted to packet-declared commits, applicable parents and blobs. Decoded source is transient and released after digest verification or workspace materialization.

errorCases.scenario: Final review revision or declared commit cannot be resolved locally.
errorCases.detection: Resolve every full object id with the local repository object database and verify it is a commit before preparing any workspace entry.
errorCases.response: Reject admission with invalid-review-revision or invalid-review-set and do not invoke the reviewer.
errorCases.userImpact: The submitter must create or restore the local commit packet and submit a new attempt.

errorCases.scenario: Selected after content is uncommitted or does not match the pinned after blob.
errorCases.detection: Resolve the selected path at the declared origin commit/final revision and compare the blob digest and selected after range/block digest with packet metadata.
errorCases.response: Reject the attempt as unpinned; never read live worktree content as a fallback.
errorCases.userImpact: The submitter must commit the intended change and create a corrected packet.

errorCases.scenario: A selected change is not present in any declared review-set commit.
errorCases.detection: Compare the selected path/transition against each declared commit-parent diff and require one exact provenance match.
errorCases.userImpact: The submitter must correct the review set or remove the out-of-scope selection.

errorCases.scenario: Merge commit has no unique applicable parent.
errorCases.detection: Inspect the merge commit's parents and find either the explicitly declared parent index/OID or exactly one parent transition matching the selected change.
errorCases.response: Reject invalid-baseline-parent; never select the first parent implicitly when ambiguous.
errorCases.userImpact: The submitter must pin the intended merge parent.

errorCases.scenario: Existing attempt workspace conflicts with the packet.
errorCases.detection: Recompute packet identity and manifest digest and compare both with the sealed workspace manifest before reuse.
errorCases.response: Fail closed with workspace-conflict; retain evidence and require a new attempt rather than mutating the pinned attempt.
errorCases.userImpact: The controller must submit a new attempt after clearing the failed attempt according to existing recovery rules.

errorCases.scenario: Materialized baseline file does not match the parent blob or escapes the attempt root.
errorCases.detection: Verify canonical destination containment, reject symlink/path traversal components, hash written bytes and compare with the local Git blob OID/digest.
errorCases.response: Abort preparation, quarantine or clean the incomplete workspace, and publish no reviewer assignment.
errorCases.userImpact: The attempt fails technically without consuming reviewer tokens.

errorCases.scenario: Checkpoint metadata references a rewritten commit or missing workspace entry during resume.
errorCases.detection: Re-resolve every pinned commit/blob and validate the sealed manifest identity before resume.
errorCases.response: Mark the attempt incomplete/failed under existing recovery semantics; do not silently rebuild it from changed Git history.
errorCases.userImpact: The controller must trigger a subsequent attempt with fresh pins.

edgeCases.input: A brand-new file selected in a commit.
edgeCases.expected: Record no before blob/path, materialize no baseline file, and retain the exact after selection and after blob digest.

edgeCases.input: A deleted file selected by deletion anchor.
edgeCases.expected: Materialize the applicable parent's file, record no after blob/path, and keep the deletion anchor as the sole selected scope.

edgeCases.input: A rename with or without content edits.
edgeCases.expected: Record old parent path/blob and new commit path/blob; materialize the old path under an unambiguous transition entry and scope review to the selected new blocks or deletion/rename anchor.

edgeCases.input: The same file changes in multiple stacked unpushed commits.
edgeCases.expected: Preserve each selected transition's own origin commit and applicable parent; materialize distinct immutable baseline entries where parent blobs differ, while the final review revision pins the final after state.

edgeCases.input: A declared commit also contains unrelated files or blocks.
edgeCases.expected: Ignore them completely because only packet-selected ranges/blocks/deletion anchors define review scope.

edgeCases.input: Two selected transitions share the same parent blob.
edgeCases.expected: Deduplicate physical baseline bytes only when manifest entries retain both logical transition identities and integrity remains explicit.
Reject admission because a review cannot proceed without at least one selected after block or deletion anchor.
Do not embed its body in packet/checkpoint memory; materialize only the required parent blob and retain size/digest metadata, with text ranges required only for textual after-block selections.

invariantsToPreserve.text: `src/daemon/threads/review-worker-preparation.ts` remains the production entry point that owns preparation before reviewer execution.
Admission, execution, packet, source and worker-checkpoint contracts remain coordinated through `src/workflow/review/code-preparation.ts`.
Checkpoint history, migration and progress behavior covered by the located preparation tests remains semantically unchanged.
Reviewer publication consumes a sealed prepared result; failed preparation never invokes the reviewer.
All source access remains attempt-scoped and is closed/released by the preparation lifecycle.

testLevels.purpose: Prove packet provenance and transition modeling without daemon concurrency.
subjects: Full-OID final revision and declared local commit validation
Selected change membership in declared commit-parent transitions
Applicable-parent resolution for normal and merge commits
New, deleted, renamed and stacked same-file transition metadata
Path containment, blob digest and manifest identity validation
fixturesNeeded: Disposable local Git repository with linear, stacked, rename, delete and merge histories
Packet fixtures containing exact after blocks and deletion anchors

testLevels.purpose: Prove source-light packet/checkpoint compatibility and unchanged lifecycle semantics.
subjects: PreparedReviewPacket locator and baseline-workspace manifest schema
Checkpoint history, migration, progress and publication compatibility
Refusal of uncommitted, unpinned, rewritten or out-of-scope inputs

testLevels.purpose: Exercise the production daemon preparation entry point with real local Git objects and filesystem materialization.
subjects: Selective immutable per-attempt baseline workspace creation and reuse
Packet-only scope when commits contain unrelated changes
Resume after interruption with unchanged pins
Concurrent reviews with isolated attempt roots
fixturesNeeded: Provider spy that records whether invocation occurred

testLevels.purpose: Qualify that a retained large review reaches reviewer invocation without eager source-body memory exhaustion and without broadening scope.
subjects: Bounded preparation memory independent of aggregate source-body size
No duplicate physical Git reads after deduplication
Reviewer prompt/context contains artifact paths, packet path, baseline workspace path and complete test evidence only

provingTests: Packet-only scope ignores unrelated files and blocks in declared commits
Uncommitted and unpinned selected changes are rejected before reviewer invocation
Linear and stacked unpushed commits resolve each selected transition from its applicable local parent
Merge transitions require and honor the applicable parent
New/delete/rename transitions produce correct before/after path and blob metadata
Same-file stacked transitions preserve distinct baselines
Only relevant parent blobs are materialized under the immutable attempt root
Workspace reuse requires identical packet and manifest digests
Prepared packets and checkpoints contain locators/digests/paths but no source bodies
Retained 171-file workload reaches provider invocation within bounded preparation memory
Checkpoint history, recovery, progress and publication regression suites remain passing
Preparation failure never publishes reviewer assignment
Reviewer input exposes Story/LLD/Plan/task, packet, baseline workspace and complete test evidence paths
Reviewer scope contains only selected after blocks and deletion anchors

testStrategy.testFramework: Node.js built-in test runner executed through `tsx --test`, following the located `*.test.ts` suites.

migration.stateBefore: Analyze bundle c1 shows production preparation in `src/workflow/review/code-preparation.ts`, called by `src/daemon/threads/review-worker-preparation.ts`, directly coordinating packet, admission, source-session, prepared-context, preparation-memory, prepared-views and worker-checkpoint contracts. The staged packet/source classes exist separately, while retained preparation eagerly holds broad source/context data and can fail before reviewer invocation.
migration.stateAfter: Every new review attempt requires a source-light packet whose exact selected after blocks/deletion anchors are pinned to local commits and a final revision. Production preparation validates each commit-parent transition, selectively creates an immutable per-attempt baseline workspace, gives the reviewer evidence paths, and retains only locators/digests/paths in checkpoint state. Existing review status, feedback history, recovery decisions and publication semantics remain intact.

migrationSteps.action: Extend packet validation and persisted derived metadata with explicit selected-transition provenance and baseline-workspace manifest identity; keep existing checkpoint review history fields unchanged.
Integrate staged packet construction and staged source ownership into production preparation, including strict release of decoded source results and fail-closed integrity checks.
Add selective per-attempt baseline workspace creation/reuse/cleanup and route the production worker's reviewer context to packet/workspace/artifact/test paths.
Switch admission for new attempts to require the new pinned transition contract and reject legacy/uncommitted inputs without a compatibility fallback.
Run packet, preparation, checkpoint, recovery, publication, concurrency and retained-load qualification; remove the eager hydration path once all production tests pass.

migration.backwardCompat: This is an intentional hard cutover for new attempts: there is no fallback that reconstructs eager hydrated packets or derives scope from commit breadth, Git status or the live worktree. Existing checkpoint history and published feedback remain readable; an incomplete pre-cutover attempt that lacks the new pins must be continued only through a separately submitted new attempt, consistent with the existing recovery rule.

alternativesConsidered.name: Attempt-scoped baseline workspace
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Keep the submitted packet as the scope contract and materialize only selected changes' applicable parent blobs into an immutable attempt directory.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Extend packet qualification to produce source-light locators and a manifest keyed by review identity, attempt, selected commit, applicable parent, path, blob digest, and exact selected after/deletion segments. Reuse staged packet construction and source access to write only required parent files into an attempt-owned temporary workspace. Reviewers open those files and repository artifacts on demand; checkpoints retain locators and manifest identity rather than decoded bodies.
pros: Directly satisfies exact-scope and commit-parent requirements
Works with stacked and unpushed local commits
Reuses staged packet and lifecycle surfaces
Bounds retained memory independently of source size
cons: Requires a manifest and strict workspace ownership/cleanup contract
Needs explicit merge-parent, rename, deletion, and new-file handling

alternativesConsidered.name: Lazy Git object source adapter
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Expose parent and after blobs lazily through ReviewSources without materializing a filesystem workspace.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Represent selected changes as immutable Git object locators and teach reviewer tools to fetch parent or after content on demand through a bounded ReviewSources adapter. Checkpoints retain only locators and digests, and every read is verified against the pinned packet.
pros: Keeps memory bounded and source reads demand-driven
cons: Review agents expect ordinary file paths and would need a new access surface
Tooling and provider prompts become coupled to the adapter
Harder to inspect manually and diagnose failed reviews
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Requires a new reviewer-access tool surface and couples independent review to live blob retrieval.

alternativesConsidered.name: Compressed prepared-context cache
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Retain the current preparation model but compress and evict decoded source bodies as limits approach.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Keep semantic hydration and prepared views, adding compression, spill-to-disk, and eviction to the existing source session and memory manager. Rehydrate bodies when a reviewer asks for them while preserving current packet structures.
cons: Preparation still broadens beyond the submitted selected blocks
Complex eviction can repeat expensive work
Does not naturally provide exact commit-parent files or ordinary immutable paths
Accuracy and scope remain dependent on eager hydration policy
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Cannot naturally represent multiple stacked parent transitions and materializes unrelated repository content.

sequenceDefinition.narrative: Shows the fail-closed preparation order: the controller submits a pinned packet, the daemon validates selected transitions against local Git, materializes only relevant parent blobs, seals the source-light checkpoint, and only then starts the reviewer.

citations.ref: The s1 deterministic structural map of code-review preparation, its production importer, direct dependencies, staged helper symbols and located tests.
The submitted review packet is the sole review scope; commits are provenance pointers; pre-change baselines come from applicable parents in the local Git graph, including stacked unpushed commits.
Repository tests use TypeScript `*.test.ts` suites executed with `npx tsx --test`.
